name: Yogiri Hayate
source:
Because Hayate grew up surrounded by her brothers, she has a boyish personality. Hayate loves helping people and solving their problems — she even goes as far as calling herself a Champion of Justice. She often takes requests from the other students and helps them out with their daily tasks.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
